detail:
Keys (NEW at lane head lock-triage-r1r7):
R7|fnn-pull-worker|swallow:serious-condition:fault,indet @ host/native/pull-service.lisp:1183 trail: protected form can signal ['fault', 'indet', 'os', 'refusal']

Hazard: pull-service.lisp:1181-1194: the release handler captures the first cleanup condition in FAILURE; the tail is (when (and failure (null primary)) (error failure)), a conjunction, so with a primary escape in flight the failure is stored at pull-service.lisp:1192 (cleanup-debt) and not rethrown here. It is not lost: fnn-pull-service-close rethrows it at pull-service.lisp:1259-1260, a retained debt blocks removal of the runtime (pull-service.lisp:1229), and the primary goes through fnn-pull-worker-guarded to fnn-owner-thread-escape (pull-service.lisp:1196-1200). R7 recognises only a tail that is exactly (when V ...) with V rethrown on every path.
fix: Rethrow locally (signal the first failure after recording the debt, whatever the primary), or teach R7 a declared debt-rethrow contract: a debt slot plus the one function that re-signals it, with a test that fails when the reader does not rethrow on every path.
title: fnn-pull-worker: the captured cleanup failure is rethrown in another function (model gap the strict R7 rule rightly cannot clear)
